platform_claims_checked.claim: An agent is an LLM in a loop. Four parts: the context it reads, the tools it can call, the goal it works toward, and the autonomy to pick its own next step.
The agent harness is the surrounding code that runs the loop. It exposes tool definitions to the LLM, executes the tool calls, and feeds results back in.
Claude Code is one harness; Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI are others.
A long run is this same loop, iterated. Nothing new takes over when the run gets long; the loop keeps choosing the next step from context and tool results, hour after hour.
List the tools you have available in this session (prompt 2) returns an introspectable, session-scoped tool list.

citations_checked.claim: ronacher-coming-loop names the outer loop as distinct
